name: syncflow-remotion
description: SyncFlow otomatik video demoları (Remotion). Siteden bağımsız paket; ../src/core ile aynı senaryo ve token verisini kullanır.

scripts.studio: npm run fonts && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.still: npm run fonts && remotion still src/index.ts WhatsAppDemo out/whatsapp-demo.png --frame=140
scripts.render: npm run fonts && remotion render src/index.ts WhatsAppDemo out/whatsapp-demo.mp4
scripts.render:showcase: npm run fonts && remotion render src/index.ts SectorShowcase out/sector-showcase.mp4
